verses.gurmukhi: ਇਕੁ ਗੁਰੂ ਇਕੁ ਸਿਖੁ ਗੁਰਮੁਖਿ ਜਾਣਿਆ।
verses.translit_en: eik guroo ik sikh gurmukh jaaniaa|

en.bdb: Gurmukhs knew very well about the one Guru (Nanak) and one disciple (Guru Angad).

verses.gurmukhi: ਗੁਰ ਚੇਲਾ ਗੁਰ ਸਿਖੁ ਸਚਿ ਸਮਾਣਿਆ।
verses.translit_en: gur chelaa gur sikh sach samaaniaa|

en.bdb: By becoming the true Sikh of the Guru, this disciple virtually merged himself into the latter.

verses.gurmukhi: ਸੋ ਸਤਿਗੁਰ ਸੋ ਸਿਖੁ ਸਬਦੁ ਵਖਾਣਿਆ।
verses.translit_en: so satigur so sikh sabadh vakhaaniaa|

en.bdb: The true Guru and the disciple were identical (in spirit) and their Word was also one.
This is the wonder of the past and the future that they (both) loved the truth.
They were beyond all accounts and were honour of the humble ones.

verses.gurmukhi: ਸਮਸਰਿ ਅੰਮ੍ਰਿਤ ਵਿਖੁ ਨ ਆਵਣ ਜਾਣਿਆ।
verses.translit_en: samasar a(n)mirat vikh na aavan jaaniaa|

en.bdb: For them, the nectar and poison were the same and they had got liberated from the cycle of transmigration
Recorded as the model of special virtues, they are known as the extremely honourable ones.

verses.gurmukhi: ਗੁਰ ਸਿਖਹੁ ਗੁਰ ਸਿਖੁ ਹੋਇ ਹੈਰਾਣਿਆ ॥੧੨॥
verses.translit_en: gur sikhahu gur sikh hoi hairaaniaa ||12||

en.bdb: The wonderful fact is that the sikh of the Guru became the Guru.
